knowledgeNodes.name: AIAG-VDA 2019 7-Step FMEA Methodology
knowledgeNodes.description: Standardized 7-step FMEA framework combining AIAG and VDA guidelines. Steps: 1. Planning, 2. Structure Analysis, 3. Function Analysis, 4. Failure Analysis, 5. Risk Analysis, 6. Optimization, 7. Documentation.

knowledgeNodes.name: PFD to PFMEA Bidirectional Linking
knowledgeNodes.description: Real-time synchronization connecting Process Flow Diagram (PFD) operation steps with PFMEA failure chain rows, automatically catching orphan steps.

knowledgeNodes.name: Control Plan Synchronization
knowledgeNodes.description: Bidirectional propagation of prevention and detection controls between PFMEA and Control Plan documents in a serializable transaction.

knowledgeNodes.name: 21 CFR Part 11 Audit Trail
knowledgeNodes.description: Immutable audit trails, role-segregated digital signatures (Creator vs Reviewer vs Approver), and document revision locks for regulatory readiness.
